checklist.item: Secrets and server texts (tokens, header values, SMTP or upstream replies, file contents) in errors, logs and responses.
checklist.evidence: loadDocFile with a fake fetch answering 500 with a marker body: 'DocsFetchError: fetching https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lorenzh/pulse-kit/<sha>/docs/index.md answered 500, expected 200', marker in message false; a throwing fetch keeps the marker only in cause. bun run build with an uncached file and a proxy URL with user and password: exit 1, output names the raw URL and ConnectionRefused, user and password 0 times. docs:bump kit with a fake git, GITHUB_TOKEN set and a local stand-in proxy answering with a marker body: 'error: https://api.github.com/repos/lorenzh/pulse-kit/git/trees/<sha>?recursive=1 answered 502', token 0 times, proxy body 0 times; the CONNECT line has no token and no proxy-authorization. The build reads no secret; ci.yml uses none. Note N4: a response.json() parse error in docs:bump can carry a token of the GitHub answer body.

checklist.item: Authentication before any other check; status codes and their order on admin routes.
checklist.evidence: No authenticated or admin routes and no deployment. The only server is the loopback static server of check:a11y (src/build/static-server.ts), unauthenticated by design: GET / 200, unknown or escaping paths 404 with 404.html, every method answers like GET.

checklist.item: Body and size limits on every method, also before any write.
checklist.evidence: Static server: POST, PUT, PATCH / with a 50 MB body -> '200 text/html; charset=utf-8 25022 bytes'; DELETE and OPTIONS with 50 MB -> ECONNRESET on the client; the server reads no body and writes nothing. Outbound: loadDocFile reads the doc whole with response.text(); a 400 MB fake body was accepted and cached ('400000010 chars'). docs:bump reads GitHub answers with response.json() without a cap. Both upstreams are fixed GitHub hosts at pinned SHAs (note N3).

checklist.item: Input validation at every trust boundary; validators never throw on any input type.
checklist.evidence: parseDocsConfig with 21 hostile values: 17 DocsConfigError, 2 accepted (key constructor, repo ../.., note N5), 2 other errors (SEC-5). docFilesFromTree, commitDate, parseLsRemote reject null, wrong types, truncated trees and ../ paths with BumpError. renderMarkdown with 15 raw-HTML vectors (block and inline HTML, comment, CDATA, processing instruction, code span, table, link title, image alt, heading, task item, callout): all escaped. Title, description and TOC escaped in the built page. Findings: a code-block language naming an inherited Object.prototype member bypasses the escaping (SEC-1) or throws (SEC-2); a malformed percent-escape stops the static server (SEC-4); docs:bump accepts prototype member names as keys (SEC-6). isSafeUrl throws TypeError on non-strings (note N7).

checklist.item: No accessor or getter of untrusted input runs.
checklist.evidence: Untrusted data enters as text: docs.config.json and GitHub answers through JSON.parse / response.json() (data properties only), Markdown as a string tokenized by marked; no input-defined accessor can exist. But LANGUAGES[language] (src/docs/highlight.ts:92) and LANGUAGE_LABEL[lang] (src/docs/markdown.ts:52) index plain objects with the code-block language of fetched Markdown: the __proto__ name runs the inherited __proto__ getter, and other names return built-in functions that highlight calls with the code text (SEC-1, SEC-2). DOC_REPOS[key] (scripts/bump-docs.ts:38) does the same with a CLI argument (SEC-6).

checklist.item: SSRF: allowed targets, environment lookups, redirects (cross-origin, https to http), forwarded headers.
checklist.evidence: Targets: the build fetches only https://raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/<sha>/<path> (src/docs/fetch.ts:18) from validated config; docs:bump only github.com and api.github.com for the six fixed DOC_REPOS. A repo ../.. passes but the host stays fixed (note N5). Environment: Bun fetch uses HTTPS_PROXY; a local listener saw 'CONNECT raw.githubusercontent.com:443 HTTP/1.1' (note N2). Redirects: default redirect follow; on loopback, Bun 1.4.0 drops authorization on a redirect to another port and to another host name ('target authorization=absent') and keeps it on a same-origin redirect, so GITHUB_TOKEN does not cross origins. https to http not tested: the redirect sources are GitHub hosts only. Forwarded headers: the static server reads only req.url (static-server.ts:26).

Path safety: cache path .cache/docs/<owner>__<name>/<sha>/<docs path> from validated values; '../..' becomes the single segment '..__..'; 'docs/../../etc.md' and '/etc/passwd' rejected; dist paths from ^[a-z]+$ keys and the docs/*.md pattern; the static server gives 404 for ../, %2f, %2e%2e, %5c, %00. Atomicity: strace of a cache miss: 'openat(.../docs/index.md, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_LARGEFILE, 0666) = 7', 'rename calls: 0'; kill -9 during a 400 MB write left 6 of 10 files torn, and the next loadDocFile returned one with 'fetch calls 0' (SEC-3). scripts/build.ts:36 to :45 removes dist/ and writes pages in place (note N8).

checklist.item: Dependencies, Docker base images and CI actions pinned and approved (docs/approved-packages.md).
checklist.evidence: Runtime: @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0, @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk 5.3.0, marked 18.1.2, preact 11.1.0, react 19.3.1, react-dom 19.3.1. Dev: @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0, @biomejs/biome 2.6.3, pulse-config by full SHA, @playwright/test 1.64.1, @types/bun 1.4.0, @types/node 26.6.6, @types/react and @types/react-dom 19.3.0, esbuild 0.28.2, lefthook 2.2.2, typescript7 npm:typescript@7.0.2. All exact and approved. Production install (--frozen-lockfile --production --ignore-scripts): 7 packages, the 6 runtime ones and scheduler (approved dependency of react-dom). bun audit: exit 1, 1 moderate, dev only (note N6). Docker: not applicable: no Dockerfile; the only compose file, test/fixtures/api-compose.yaml, is a copy of the pulse-api compose file that src/content/facts.test.ts reads as text; the website builds and runs no image. CI: check uses pulse-config check.yml at 86896e9..., which pins actions/checkout@3d3c42e... (v7.0.1) with persist-credentials: false and oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e... (v2.2.0); the site job pins the same SHAs with persist-credentials: false; permissions contents: read; trigger pull_request. All pins approved. bunx playwright resolves to the locked 1.64.1 bin; the browser download is not pinned by hash (note N9).

findings.title: HTML injection through the code-block highlighter: an Object.prototype member name as language skips escaping
findings.class: Stored HTML injection at build time via a prototype-chain lookup with an untrusted key (LANGUAGES[language], then tokenize(code); called from src/docs/markdown.ts:100)
findings.command: Render a fenced block whose language names an inherited Object.prototype member, with markup as body, through renderMarkdown; then add the same block to one cached doc, run bun run build, bun run check:links, bun run check:a11y, and query the page in Chromium
findings.excerpt: rawMarkupInOutput=true (json, yaml, bash, html: false); Chromium: {"paragraphElement":true,"insideCodeElement":true,"linkElement":true,"linkHref":"https://pulse.invalid/login"}; check:links: 'links ok, csp ok on 39 pages' exit 0; check:a11y: 'a11y ok' exit 0
findings.impact: Whoever lands a Markdown change in a published docs/*.md of one of the six docs repositories can put arbitrary non-script HTML (off-site links, fake text or notices) into the website, and every CI gate passes. The source is an ordinary fenced code block, so a docs reviewer reads it as code, and docs:bump pulls it in. The CSP meta tag blocks inline script; check:links fails on an extra script and axe fails on a meta refresh. No pinned doc uses such a language today.
findings.fixDirection: Look up tokenizers and labels in a Map or an Object.create(null) object, or check Object.hasOwn first; always escape output that does not come from an own tokenizer; add a test over every Object.prototype member name.

findings.title: Docs cache written in place; a torn cache file is trusted by every later build
findings.command: strace -f -e trace=openat,rename,renameat,renameat2 of a cache miss with a fake fetch; 10 runs that kill -9 a 400 MB cache write; then loadDocFile on the same cache directory
findings.excerpt: openat(.../lorenzh__pulse-kit/<sha>/docs/index.md, O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_LARGEFILE, 0666) = 7; rename calls: 0; run 5: size 400000010, x bytes 29360119 of 400000000, last byte '\0'; incomplete: 6 of 10; next read: 400000010 chars, fetch calls 0, ends with newline false

findings.excerpt: nope: error: unknown repo "nope", expected one of api, probe, status, notify, contract, kit; member names: fake git called with: ls-remote https://github.com/<native function text>.git refs/heads/main, or https://github.com/[object Object].git

notes: N1: unsafeRefs (src/build/html-refs.ts:126) reads only href, src, action, poster and srcset, as documented; javascript: in xlink:href, formaction and object data is not flagged, nor srcdoc. CSP blocks them. isSafeUrl fuzz against the WHATWG URL parser: 2,548 variants, 0 judged safe that parse to another scheme.
N2: Bun fetch in scripts/build.ts:21 and scripts/bump-docs.ts:19 uses HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY (CONNECT seen at a local listener); TLS stays end to end; no token in the CONNECT head.
N3: src/docs/fetch.ts:45 (response.text()) and scripts/bump-docs.ts:25 (response.json()) read bodies without a size cap; a 400 MB fake body was accepted; hosts fixed, docs pinned by SHA.
N4: scripts/bump-docs.ts:25 passes response.json() parse errors through; Bun can quote a body token in that message (notify audit); not reproduced here, URL fixed to api.github.com.

N5: REPO (src/docs/config.ts:15) accepts . and .. segments ('../..' passes; host stays raw.githubusercontent.com; cache folder '..__..'); KEY accepts 'constructor', which stays an own property and is rejected by the nav check.
N6: bun audit exit 1: minimatch@10.2.6 moderate GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, via @eslint/config-array from eslint 10.13.0 of pulse-config, dev only.
N7: isSafeUrl throws TypeError on undefined, null, number, object, symbol and bigint; typed string, all callers pass strings.
N8: scripts/build.ts:36 to :45 removes dist/ and writes pages in place; a stopped build leaves a partial dist/; no deployment yet; not reproduced with a kill test.
N9: CI site job runs bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium; Playwright pinned 1.64.1 by the lockfile, the browser download is not pinned by hash in the repository.
N10: renderMarkdown on a list nested 2,000 deep (about 4 MB) took 133,878 ms; 5,000 nested blockquotes 481 ms; build time only, site job timeout 20 minutes.
N11: the static server answers POST, PUT and PATCH like GET, reads no body and writes nothing.
